The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Empire's Wrath|later known]] as the [[Emperor's Wrath]] was given a '''[[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|''Fury''-class Imperial interceptor]]''' by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] master, [[Darth Baras]], during the search for [[Jaesa Willsaam]].
